character: A Catskills resort in the village of Hunter, operated by Vail Resorts. It is one of the larger ski areas within a few hours' drive of New York City, so weekends can be busy.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at the base. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Nov 21, 2026 for 2026-27 (a third-party projection, not an announcement; checked 2026-09-30). Vail Resorts released its 2026/27 opening dates on Aug 18, 2026, but the search summary did not show Hunter's date — check the release (More links). Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived. OnTheSnow (third party, fetched 2026-10-03) gives an "estimated start date of 2026 Nov 21 and a tentative end date of 2027 Apr 04" - a projection, not an announcement.
